description: Re-key a page by slug (draft or published static). Server-side hash copy — no body round-trip. Default deletes static routes (obscure-URL); movePath:true repoints the route, rewrites menu refs and other redirects aimed at the old path, rewrites root-relative and https://{slug}.dotsy.site/ hrefs in draft HTML (always linksRewritten; not custom-domain absolutes or script/code samples; linksRewriteTruncated when scan caps at 100 HTML keys (500 on sites with full content search); publish to ship), and — only for an already-PUBLISHED page — leaves a 301 there too (leaveRedirect, default true; no effect on a never-published page, or when movePath is false). Retry-safe: a part-way failure (409 rename_failed) rolls everything back, so resend the same call. On fragments/<name>.html it also rewrites every <dotsy-fragment name> reference and hide marker in the same all-or-nothing commit. Then publish_site.

leaveRedirect.description: With movePath:true on an already-published page, leave a 301 at the old path (default true). false removes the old path outright — old links break. No effect when movePath is false, or on a page that was never published.

movePath.description: false (default): delete routes bound to old key. true: move static route path to match slug.

newSlug.description: New filename stem; directory prefix preserved (blog/foo → blog/bar)

name: rename_content
